headline: This update speeds up interaction animations in BetterBags Next and prevents accidentally picking up items when dragging sections.

entries.title: Moving a section no longer picks up an item
entries.details: Releasing a dragged section in BetterBags Next will no longer accidentally pick up the item under the cursor or display item tooltips while dragging.

entries.title: Faster interaction animations in BetterBags Next
entries.details: Animations in BetterBags Next now share a unified, snappier duration of 0.24 seconds when sorting, looting, switching tabs, and rearranging sections.
